Interesting — the interactions report "nothing at 2,6", "nothing at 2,8", "nothing at 1,7", "nothing at 3,7". So the notice board is NOT actually at (2,7) as a targetable object in front — it's on my tile. And I can't move off.

This is a hard stuck state. Let me reconsider: maybe the notice board is a solid object and I spawned inside it, and the game won't let me move because every adjacent tile check fails. But (3,7) is the player's tile and should be walkable.

Let me try a much longer hold and check stamina/position, and also try diagonal-ish by holding two keys.
